`.cursor/rules/java-springboot.mdc` now holds the Java 21 + Spring Boot 3 REST conventions.

**Frontmatter:** `globs: ["**/*.java"]`, `alwaysApply: false`.

**What it covers:**
- Package layout under `com.ticketing` (controller, service, repository, domain, DTO, exception, mapper)
- Layering: controllers stay HTTP-only, services own transactions and rules, repositories stay data-only, entities never go on the wire
- Exceptions: `AppException` + `ErrorCode`, one `@RestControllerAdvice`, stable error body
- Lombok: no `@Data` on entities, no `@SneakyThrows`, records preferred for DTOs
- Naming for types, methods, paths, enums

The rule applies when Java files are in context, not on every chat.
